messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "one to two additional doses given at intervals of 4 to 6 hours"
set: ["one to two additional doses given at intervals of 4 to 6 hours", "4 to 6 hours", "2 inhalations every 4 to 6 hours", "take 4 to 6 hours after resin", "6 to 12 hours", "6 to 15 hours", "do not use two doses at one time", "do not take two doses at one time", "do not use two doses of semaglutide at one time", "given as two 100 mg doses", "subsequent doses given every 12 hours", "subsequent doses given 4 and 8 hours after first dose", "Do not take two doses at once to make up for a missed one", "immediate-release tablets should be given at least 6 hours apart", "taken every 4 to 6 hours as needed for pain", "1 to 2 tablets every 4 to 6 hours as needed for pain"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
